summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of model options not being cleared when squashing migrations, but it may introduce unexpected behavior.

issues.description: The patch modifies the behavior of `CreateModel.reduce()` by removing options not present in `operation.options`. This could lead to unintended side effects if other operations rely on the presence of certain options.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify that the changes do not introduce regressions or unexpected behavior in other scenarios.
